Yu Hojo.name: Yu Hojo
Yu Hojo.basicInfo:
Yu Hojo, one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, Kai Chisaki's sworn enforcers, who works with his friends Toya Setsuno and Soramitsu Tabe. Tall, muscular and bald, with shadowed eyes and a plain medical mask.
Speaking Style: Blunt and plain; says little and means it.
Combat Role: Armored striker: grows sharp crystals from his skin to hit with and hide behind.
Under Pressure: Plants himself in front of Setsuno and Tabe.
Yu Hojo.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He resents people who use others, and serves a house that uses everyone. Motivation: His friends; the house took the three of them in when nobody else would. Connections: Toya Setsuno and Soramitsu Tabe, his closest companions; Kai Chisaki (Overhaul), the boss they serve. Knowledge: The tunnels, the Trigger trade and his orders. Thread: The house or his friends, if it comes to a choice.
QUIRK: Crystallize. Hard, sharp crystals grow from his skin for striking and protection; contact range only, and a heavy enough blow breaks them.
personality: Blunt: Says plainly what he thinks, without polish.
Resents users: Bristles at anyone who treats people as tools.
Protective: Covers Setsuno and Tabe before himself.
Speaking style: Short, blunt and restrained.
abilities: Crystallize: Grows sharp crystals from his skin to strike at close range; no reach beyond his body.
Crystal guard: Coats himself in crystal to take blows; protection, not invulnerability.
Fighting style: Advances behind his crystals and strikes up close, covering Setsuno and Tabe.
Yu Hojo.visualDescription: A tall, muscular bald man with a heavy brow, deep-set eyes in dark shadow and light skin, a plain white medical mask over his nose and mouth. He wears a plain dark shirt and dark trousers. Thick neck and broad shoulders. The mask sits snug over his lower face, leaving only the shadowed eyes and the bare scalp visible. A quiet, guarded, unsmiling expression.
